comment: She's extremely understanding if there is any mishap you may have. Her class is hard but her instructions are very clear and you just have to pay attention and read the syllabus carefully and you'll succeed. She's a great professor and I would 100% take her class again.

Dr. G is an approachable and helpful professor who enjoys helping students when they ask. Her classes, which are of reasonable difficulty, tend to be slide-heavy and draw upon case studies from the outside world. She is clear with her expectations and a fair grader. Participation is important in class, and Dr. G provides ample opprotunities for it.
My favorite Jepson professor, truly a gem. Tests are straightforward, assignments are straightforward, grading is fair

Dr. Garifullina is a  good professor. Readings and homework for Dictators and Rebels was easily manageable. Every week she did require the class to submit reading questions and it was a requirement that each student had to present on one of the readings twice during the semester. She loves interactive games too, so be prepared to participate.

Dr. G is a great professor who teaches a fairly - but not unreasonably - difficult class, doing so with flexibility and care. Her office hours are a must, and she does a great job explaining and walking you through any problems you might encounter. If you pay attention, do the work outside of class, and come into office hours, you'll be fine.

Dr. Guzel was a wonderful professor and her class was very interesting! There's usually 1 reading per week that you leave comments on, she gives out tons of participation points, there's a group project, and a final paper. She is so very friendly and always happy to help and her feedback is great!

Dr. Guzel is very laid back and I liked how she taught the class (good combo of lectures, group work, and games). Readings each week but they are not too bad. 2 papers, one take-home midterm, a group project, and a final all had clear grading criteria. She gives a lot of participation points so make sure to participate!

Professor Garifullina is a great lecturer and very knowledgable about Russian politics. Grades are based on weekly readings, some in-class writings, and two exams (both open-notes). If you do your readings and participate in class you will be fine!

Guzel is very laid back and makes everyone feel comfortable participating in class. She is a fair grader and makes the exams relatively easy - as long as you explain your answer it is likely you will do well. She did assign a fair amount of reading - one research paper each class. She used real world examples and activities into the class
